fact: Cabo Verde's Casa do Cidadão publicly launched the Participa Cidadão app on 1 February 2017 as an online channel for complaints, suggestions and praise about public services; no case numbers are given.

The Ombudsman and Casa do Cidadao signed a service-level agreement on 19 January that makes the eparticipa.gov.cv platform available for citizens' complaints, reports and suggestions to the Ombudsman, plus a free green line; no case numbers are given.
